projects.name: KIIT Sync
projects.description: A campus companion app for KIIT students featuring timetable management, attendance tracking, subject analytics, and mess menus. Used by 50+ students.

projects.name: AI Interview Platform
projects.description: A full-stack voice-based AI mock interview system that conducts real-time contextual interviews using Gemini Flash, Groq, and Whisper, with adaptive follow-up questions and personalized interview flows.

projects.name: Neuro-Nav-AI
projects.description: An AI-powered assistive navigation system for visually impaired users that combines YOLOv8 object detection, TensorFlow Lite, Arduino sensors, and voice guidance to provide real-time offline navigation.
